boundaries.obligation: PoseidonHashOut (private-state commitment, SettledTransfer nullifier, all tree hashing) must be collision resistant; the model treats it as an opaque callback and states binding only for explicitly compared preimage pairs.

boundaries.name: merkle_openings
boundaries.obligation: SentTxMerkleProof, TxMerkleProof, TxV2MerkleProof, the transfer-tree proof and the AccountState openings must be sound Merkle-inclusion gadgets at the stated heights; the model consumes only their boolean results.

boundaries.name: sent_tx_tree_contents
boundaries.obligation: That private_state.sent_tx_tree_root contains only transactions the sender actually funded and deducted is enforced by the balance/spend circuits, not here; this file only opens tx at index tx.nonce.

boundaries.name: block_validity_anchoring
boundaries.obligation: That account_tree_root of the OUTPUT public state, and the send_leaf it opens, correspond to an on-chain posted block is discharged by the validity proof and by the withdrawal chain / IntmaxRollup, not by this circuit.

boundaries.name: nullifier_freshness
boundaries.obligation: Double-withdrawal prevention is the L1 used[nullifier] ledger in IntmaxRollup; this circuit only computes the nullifier from a bound preimage and claims no freshness or uniqueness.

boundaries.name: public_input_consumption
boundaries.obligation: The 45-limb layout must match what withdrawal_step.rs keccak-chains and what RollupValue.foldWithdrawalLeaf / verifyWithdrawalSet consume on L1; only the limb offsets and the 5-field leaf projection are stated here.

boundaries.name: native_witness_effects
boundaries.obligation: WitnessWrite canonical field conversions, dummy TxV2 proof filling and the plonky2 prover are opaque; no admission check beyond to_public_inputs is invented.

boundaries.name: serialization_and_fixtures
boundaries.obligation: to_bytes/from_bytes and the #[cfg(test)] witness generators were read, not translated; circuit-data equality after a round trip is not modeled.
